lanes.source: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
steps: resolve each sample parcel local authority
match exact official ID first, then point-in-polygon
write no_data when no authoritative polygon match exists
intersect sample geometry or centroid with coverage metadata
verify product type, year, resolution and checksum
preserve published vertical accuracy and source date
derive British National Grid tile from sample coordinates
download only required 10 km ASCII grid tiles
use as official national fallback or crosscheck
reuse verified public COG only when the shard sample lies inside its bounds
do not promote as sole official UK DTM validation
compare against EA LiDAR or OS Terrain result

merge_gate: real parcel geometry or documented centroid binding exists
at least one official UK numeric elevation source sampled
source resolution, date, method and confidence recorded
web operation row and remote readback produced
example_selection_rule: first three unresolved canonical parcel IDs inside 61523-92283 after deterministic registry read
